description: Source code for the Kubernetes Pod Security Admission controller, implementing core admission logic, policy evaluation, and namespace/pod validation.

classes.name: Admission
classes.description: Core admission logic for Pod Security, handling namespace and pod validation, policy evaluation, and pod prioritization.

classes.name: PodLister
classes.description: Interface for listing pods within a namespace.

classes.name: PodSpecExtractor
classes.description: Interface for extracting PodSpec from pod-controller resources.

classes.name: DefaultPodSpecExtractor
classes.description: Default implementation of PodSpecExtractor for common resource types.

classes.name: podCount
classes.description: Helper struct to track pods sharing warnings during namespace validation.

methods.name: CompleteConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up default or derived configuration for the Admission object.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the Admission configuration is complete and correct.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Main entry point for validating admission requests based on resource type.

methods.name: ValidateNamespace
methods.description: Validates namespace create/update requests and policy application.

methods.name: ValidatePod
methods.description: Validates pod create/update requests against policies.

methods.name: ValidatePodController
methods.description: Validates pod controller requests against policies.

methods.name: EvaluatePod
methods.description: Evaluates a pod against the policy, returning allowed/forbidden responses.

methods.name: EvaluatePodsInNamespace
methods.description: Checks existing pods in a namespace for violations of the enforce policy.

methods.name: exemptNamespace
methods.description: Checks if a namespace is exempt from policy enforcement.

methods.name: exemptUser
methods.description: Checks if a user is exempt from policy enforcement.

methods.name: exemptRuntimeClass
methods.description: Checks if a runtime class is exempt from policy enforcement.

methods.name: prioritizePods
methods.description: Filters and prioritizes pods for evaluation based on runtime class and controller uniqueness.

methods.name: PolicyToEvaluate
methods.description: Determines the policy to evaluate based on namespace labels.

methods.name: isSignificantPodUpdate
methods.description: Determines if a pod update should trigger policy re-evaluation.

methods.name: isSignificantContainerUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a container update is significant for policy evaluation.

methods.name: decoratePodWarnings
methods.description: Prefixes warnings with related pod names for clarity.

methods.name: exemptNamespaceWarning
methods.description: Generates a warning if an exempt namespace has a non-privileged policy.
